svg.title: Fig. 149(c) — Curves parallel to the hyperbola
svg.desc: Redrawn from Robert C. Yates, A Handbook on Curves and Their Properties (1947), Fig. 149(c), page 157. Section: parallel.

g.data-text: The two branches of the hyperbola (thin).
At a series of points of each branch take the normal (the faint lines) and lay off k along it towards the centre and away from it.

Draw the parallel curves: on the convex side each branch gives a hyperbola-like curve; on the concave side k is larger than the radius of curvature at the vertex, so there are two cusps and the arms cross.
